description: Akashi Tool Router: 80 tools from 33 providers behind one Pocket service, for AI agents. Web search and page reading, cited answers, research papers, news, weather (16-day forecasts and history since 1940), maps and geocoding, crypto prices and FX, GitHub and packages, time zones and holidays, dictionaries and more. POST /v1/discover {query} ranks tools for a job with price and health; POST /v1/inspect {id} returns a tool's input and output JSON Schemas and an example; POST /v1/run/{provider}/{endpoint} with the tool's input as the JSON body runs it; GET /v1/catalog lists every tool. Every response is a JSON object; errors are {"error":{"code","message","retryable"}} with 4xx/5xx, never a partial answer presented as success.

rpc_types.backend_hint: akashi-api (FastAPI) on :8000; relayer rest url http://<api-host>:8000 (no path prefix)
rpc_types.notes: GET /v1/version, /v1/health, /v1/catalog; POST /v1/discover, /v1/inspect, /v1/run/{provider}/{endpoint}. Inputs only in the JSON body. Every response is a JSON object.

serving.backend: The akashi-api container behind an HA RelayMiner (rest backend at the container root). It calls third-party APIs with the operator's own keys (configured as environment variables) plus keyless public APIs; tools whose keys are missing are reported unavailable in the catalog, never half-run. Needs outbound HTTPS and a Redis for cache and health.

healthcheck.notes: Functional probe: ranks the local catalog, no upstream call.

serving.notes: Runs answer in under 9 s (per-tool deadlines); request bodies up to 64 KiB; outputs capped near 60 KB. Gateway operators: configure as type passthrough with rpc_types ["rest"].
